title: The People Not Worth Replacing
summary: At first glance, MAGA’s fear of immigrants and the rest of America’s fear of data centers have many similarities, with each reflecting insecurities about one’s place in a changing economy. But while the first fear tells natives that their place is valuable, the second assumes that it will soon be worth nothing.

title: What Amodei’s Call for an AI Pause Gets Wrong
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s recent appeal for a pause on AI development is a welcome one. But while AI companies do indeed need more breathing space to consider the full impact of their inventions before releasing them to the market, self-interested oversight is not the kind of governance we need.

title: The Strategic Asset Europe Has Overlooked
summary: Europe’s soil is gradually dying, and yet the continent has still not recognized it as a strategic asset. Fortunately, the EU has many of the tools it needs to act, but doing so will require an overarching framework that helps farmers access financial rewards for measurable soil outcomes.

title: Who Is Responsible for Nepal’s Tragedy?
summary: The devastating floods in Nepal demonstrate what happens when reckless development puts climate-vulnerable communities in harm’s way. They also highlight a climate-finance system that is unable to provide the funds countries need in the immediate aftermath of such disasters.

title: Europe Must Choose Between Power and Dependence
summary: European citizens do not want “more Europe” in the abstract, but rather a European Union that is capable of protecting, investing, anticipating, deciding, and acting whenever national-level policymaking is insufficient. In today’s world, ensuring citizens’ control over their future requires the freedom to act together.

title: Progressive Economics Is Delivering
summary: By combining fiscal responsibility, growth, and social development, progressive governments in Brazil and Spain have improved millions of people’s lives and refuted the hoary belief that conservatives are better stewards of the economy. Such a successful alternative model could not have come at a better time.
